title: Bounded index lookup
summary: Test whether an index over repeated lookups reduces retrieval latency in the supplied baseline.
opportunity_statement: Repeated lookup may be a retrieval bottleneck. An index could remove the repeated work, so test whether it lowers latency without changing answer quality.
constraints: Evaluate an intervention intended to reduce retrieval latency
risks: Index maintenance could offset lookup gains

other_dispositions.reason: Requires a proprietary model, which the rubric forbids.
